scope: Supervised alpha pilot; bounded automatic discovery/freshness and version-matched baseline checks, not exhaustive machine coverage or population recall.

baseline_replay.comparison_exception: Only credential-detector analyzer_version a3 -> a4 normalized for equality; original reports preserve actual versions. Other finding fields unchanged.
baseline_replay.admission: Historical file versions were retained as gaps. Device-only renumbered current inputs were separately admitted only with matching baseline content digests. Unavailable/changed content was not counted as a miss or a pass.

automatic_discovery.selection: Automatic / and shipped home seeds resumed from encrypted snapshot; no selected-folder source or injected inventory rows. Existing exclusions included browser/vault stores, cloud stores, mounted/network volumes and task staging.
automatic_discovery.alias_pack: corpPassword:password; positive controls used the custom alias

native_gui.method: Computer-use check of exact packaged native renderer, followed by independent backend reopen

limits: Full-machine backfill remains incomplete; no population precision/recall claim.
This bounded run did not prove oldest-queue completion or a global wait bound.
A prior candidate recovered one generic scan-failed slice whose cause is unconfirmed; none recorded in this combined bounded trial.
Polling, not native events/read auditing; fresh profile polling defaults to one hour.
No new Windows/Linux or remote-source platform qualification in this release.
Recursive archives/OCR/obfuscation search and arbitrary job/transport plugins are not implemented.
